name: AIGMos_Structure_Projector_Topic_Profile
purpose: Define software-specific Structure Projector topics and the relationship surfaces that should be discoverable for each topic without hard-coding AIGMos semantics into Structure Projector itself.

portability.rule: Structure Projector must load software-specific topic profiles instead of embedding software-specific topic names or semantics in the projector core.

topic_model.topic: A semantic subject the user wants to inspect.
topic_model.subtopic: A more specific semantic subject under a topic.
topic_model.lens: A projection dimension applied to a selected topic.
topic_model.integration_surface: A related runtime, symbol, interface, data, authority or execution surface that may connect to the selected topic.
topic_model.rule: Topics select WHAT is being inspected. Lenses select HOW it is projected. Integration surfaces show HOW the topic connects to the wider software system.

topics.label: Domain MetaModules
topics.rule: Domain MetaModules are Composition MetaModules specialized for a domain.

integration_surfaces.label: Symbols
relation_questions: Which symbols does this topic own?
Which symbols does this topic read?
Which symbols does this topic write?
Which symbols does this topic expose?
Which namespaces reference this topic?

integration_surfaces.label: Commands
relation_questions: Which commands operate on this topic?
Which commands are owned by this topic?
Which commands produce or modify this topic?

integration_surfaces.label: REST
relation_questions: Which REST surfaces expose this topic?
Which REST inputs target this topic?
Which REST responses project this topic?

integration_surfaces.label: EXP
relation_questions: Which EXP surfaces expose this topic?
Which semantic values are projected through EXP?

integration_surfaces.label: User Modules
relation_questions: Which User Modules implement, project or operate on this topic?
Which primitive UserModule types are involved?

integration_surfaces.label: Triggers
relation_questions: Which triggers can initiate behavior related to this topic?
Which conditions activate those triggers?

integration_surfaces.label: Events
relation_questions: Which events does this topic emit?
Which events does this topic consume?

integration_surfaces.label: Runners
relation_questions: Which runners execute behavior related to this topic?
Which operations are executed by those runners?

integration_surfaces.label: Routines
relation_questions: Which routines contain behavior related to this topic?
Where in an ordered routine does the topic participate?

integration_surfaces.label: DWH
relation_questions: What data does this topic read?
What data does this topic write?
Which DWH owns the resolved data?
Does the flow cross an EXT boundary?

integration_surfaces.label: AccessCore
relation_questions: Which permissions apply to this topic?
Which authority controls access?
Which delegated authority boundaries apply?

integration_surfaces.label: Expose
relation_questions: How is this topic projected to humans?
Which pages, views, forms or controls expose it?

semantic_roles.actor_ref: WHO performs or owns the step
semantic_roles.condition_ref: WHEN or under what condition the step occurs

flow_projection.rule: Execution causality must come from explicit flow data. Structure Projector must not infer execution order or causality from dependency, containment, ownership, authority, membership, visual position or generic relations.

projector_rules: Topic profile must not create canonical semantics.
Topics are software-specific navigation concepts, not canonical authorities.
A topic may map to one or more canonical semantic identities.
A semantic identity may appear under multiple topic views without becoming multiple semantic nodes.
Topic membership must not imply containment, ownership, authority or dependency.
Integration surfaces describe discoverable relationship classes, not automatic relationships.
Missing canonical relationship data must be reported as unavailable or ambiguous rather than inferred.
Structure Projector core must remain reusable with another software-specific topic profile.
